description: This Java source file defines the MonkeySourceNetwork class, which implements a network-based event source for the Android Monkey testing tool. It handles network commands to simulate user input events, manage command execution, and communicate over a socket connection.

classes.name: MonkeySourceNetwork
classes.description: Implements a network server that receives commands for the Android Monkey testing tool, translating network input into Monkey events and managing command execution flow.

classes.name: MonkeyCommandReturn
classes.description: Represents the result of executing a Monkey command, indicating success or failure and an optional message.

classes.name: MonkeyCommand
classes.description: Interface for Monkey commands that can translate command lines into Monkey events.

classes.name: CommandQueue
classes.description: Interface for a command queue that can enqueue Monkey events.

classes.name: CommandQueueImpl
classes.description: Implementation of CommandQueue using a linked list to store Monkey events.

classes.name: DeferredReturn
classes.description: Holds a deferred Monkey command return value, waiting for a specific event or timeout before returning.

methods.name: MonkeySourceNetwork
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a server socket on a specified port.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Starts the network server, accepting a client connection, setting up input/output streams, and waking the device.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Closes the client socket and tears down view setup, stopping the server.

methods.name: replaceQuotedChars
methods.description: Replaces escaped quotes in a string with actual quote characters.

methods.name: commandLineSplit
methods.description: Splits a command line into tokens, respecting quoted strings as single tokens.

methods.name: translateCommand
methods.description: Parses and executes a command line, translating it into Monkey events.

methods.name: handleReturn
methods.description: Handles the result of a command execution, sending OK or ERROR responses.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Main loop to accept commands over the network, process queued events, handle deferred returns, and produce Monkey events.

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Sends an ERROR response over the network.

methods.name: returnError
methods.description: Sends an ERROR response with a message.

methods.name: returnOk
methods.description: Sends an OK response over the network.

methods.name: returnOk
methods.description: Sends an OK response with a value.
